create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter to track running average and current value of metrics
update_average_meter: update an AverageMeter with a new value and optional sample count
create_time_meter: create a TimeMeter to compute average occurrences of events per second
create_stopwatch_meter: create a StopwatchMeter to measure sum and average duration of timed events
reset_meters: reset an AverageMeter, TimeMeter, or StopwatchMeter to clear accumulated state
